items.title: The quasi-coherent presheaf associated to a module satisfies the sheaf condition
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a quasi-coherent module F on a scheme S and a topology tau among Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic, fppf and fpqc, the lemma asserts that the functor of (equation-quasi-coherent-presheaf) satisfies the sheaf condition for every tau-covering of every scheme T over S (statement lines 2374-2383). The proof reduces to the fpqc case by the chain of inclusions among the topologies, which are quoted from Topologies; then a family of compatible sections of f_i^* f^* F over the covering is reinterpreted as a family of maps O_{T_i} -> f_i^* f^* F compatible with the canonical descent data on O_T and f^* F, and the fpqc descent proposition for quasi-coherent modules descends these to a unique map O_T -> f^* F, which is the required section (proof lines 2385-2408). The level is H3: the reinterpretation of sections as maps out of the structure sheaf is the conceptual step, and the descent input is a genuine effectivity statement whose hypotheses are checked in the span.
